arguments:
{"script":"mkdir -p files_list
cat > count_ext.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 .ext listfile" >&2
  exit 2
fi

ext="$1"
listfile="$2"

if [[ ! "$ext" =~ ^\.[a-z]{3}$ ]]; then
  echo "Extension must be a dot and three lowercase letters (e.g. .txt)" >&2
  exit 2
fi

if [ ! -d "files_list" ]; then
  echo "Directory files_list not found" >&2
  exit 2
fi

cd files_list

if [ ! -f "$listfile" ]; then
  echo "List file '$listfile' not found in files_list" >&2
  exit 2
fi

ext_escaped="${ext//./\\.}"
regex="${ext_escaped}$"

count=$(grep -E -c "$regex" "$listfile" || true)
echo "$count"
EOF
chmod +x count_ext.sh
printf "Created files: %s\n" "count_ext.sh"
echo "---- script content ----"
sed -n '1,200p' count_ext.sh
"}
